questions.scenario: What happens when you branch at message_index=5?
questions.explanation: branch() deep-copies messages up to the specified index into a new node.

questions.scenario: Why does SessionTree deep-copy messages when branching?
options: To prevent modifications in one branch from affecting others
questions.explanation: Deep copy ensures branch isolation — changes in one branch never affect the parent or siblings.

options: Creates a branch at the end of a node, continuing where it left off
questions.explanation: /resume branches from the current end of a node, effectively continuing a previous session.
